summary.text:
Vakyartha (`vak`) is a local-first agent harness for one owner: agents that work on code, documents, research and everyday tasks, reached from a desktop app, the browser, a terminal and chat apps, with every model input and tool result kept in an append-only record. Its thesis is strong safety, transparent operation, extensible integrations and a simple core.

The lower layers (storage, permission, the pure deciders, the document engines) are well shaped and change rarely. Above them, three large crates (`vak-core`, `vak-agent`, `vak-server`) hold the turn and most features, and that is where most of the work and most of the risk sit.

findings.title: A turn's decisions share mutable state inside two outlier functions
findings.evidence: Clippy's `cognitive_complexity` scores `Agent::run_message_inner` at 193 (rank 1 of 4,414 library functions) and `Core::run_turn_recorded` at 106 (rank 3); the median is 3 and the 99th percentile 24. 153 commits changed the first (6% of all) and 213 the second (9%). Fix commits land in `vak-core/src/lib.rs` at 10.3 and `vak-agent/src/lib.rs` at 8.5 per thousand lines, against a median of 4.4 over 403 files; file size alone does not predict the rate (ρ = -0.13).
findings.matters: The loop keeps the turn's decisions in mutable locals that every step and every call result updates. `948ece43d` fixed two bugs of exactly that kind: `receipts.unresolved_error` was cleared by a later success in the same batch even when an earlier call had failed, and `verification_stale` came out stale or not depending on which parallel result returned first. Both were fixed by moving the decision into a pure function over the whole batch, tested on its own.
findings.fix: Do that for the rest: the turn's state as one type, each decision a pure function of it, and the end-of-turn checks (among them goal mode's audit, the managed-work gate and the commitment hold, which judge durable work at different scopes on purpose) as one ordered list with tests of how they combine. Context planning and the model call can stay as they are.

findings.title: Storage's guarantees are not tested in the shapes that broke them
findings.evidence: Owning the storage layer is a decision (docs/decisions.md, 2026-10-18), and it is tested for torn writes, crashes, fsync paths and injected faults, with a fuzz corpus. FinOps now compares its row projection with a direct fold, but the underlying chain reader still lacks an independent reference model, and few tests run two writer processes. The two P1 faults of 2026-10-18 needed exactly those shapes: a cached grant that kept authorizing because its revocation sat in an unreadable segment (A01), and a writer paused between the epoch check and the ref update (A02). A review's probes found them, not the suite. Repeated takeover tests now expose and cover import invalidation of encrypted projections: a standby catalog cannot outlive the imported keys. The seal-manifest verifier blind spot found on 2026-10-20 is fixed; broader interleaving and independent-reader gaps remain.
findings.matters: These are the guarantees authorization, erasure and sync rest on. A bug here does not show as a failed turn; it shows as access that should have ended, or a write that should have been fenced.
findings.fix: A model-based test of each chain's reader against a reference, and multi-process interleavings of every fenced write path.

findings.title: The securely confined rendered browser does not launch local Chrome
findings.evidence: The public example.com smoke on 2026-10-20 exits without a DOM under the new screened-proxy and native filesystem policy. Private-profile Unix IPC and private-destination rejection tests pass, but neither establishes working page rendering. The tool returns a typed error and recommends ordinary fetch; it never retries unconfined. Restricted Landlock and Docker workers also refuse until their backends enforce control-file exclusions.
findings.matters: Script-built pages currently lose rendered browsing on the measured Mac, and unqualified restricted backends lose worker/parser/MCP availability. Safe refusal closes the unsafe execution path but does not establish feature parity.
findings.fix: Qualify browser launch and backend control-file enforcement with real process tests, preserving proxy-only TCP, private profile state and mandatory secret/control exclusions.
findings.sources: [Security hardening acceptance](../docs/audits/security-hardening-2026-10-20.md); the ignored public-page browser smoke and native IPC tests.

keep.name: The worker boundary
keep.text: A versioned protocol with 14 task kinds; parsers and tools never run in the server process.

keep.name: Effects, runs, cursors
keep.text: At-most-once outbound actions and unknown outcomes that are never re-sent automatically.

keep.name: The provenance gate
keep.text: Owner input and unknown editable context carry conservative provenance; private plus untrusted content requires unpreauthorizable approval for mutations and outbound tool calls in restricted modes. Remote answer media stay inert until a person follows a link.

keep.name: The completion judges
keep.text: Whether a deliverable was produced, whether it met its requirements, a run's audited goal, a work contract and a commitment are judged separately on purpose, so produced output can never pass for proof.

ring.what: Events a reconnecting client can catch up on (EventBus ring)

wait_tick.what: How often a parent looks at a worker it waits on

delta.what: One wire frame per text delta

append.what: The screen renders the whole answer's markdown again on every delta

snapshot.what: Every in-process delta carries the whole message so far (invariant 4)

breaker.what: Circuit breaker cooldown after blind failures

day_cap.what: The operator's day budget; admission stops when it is spent

rate_gate.what: Requests wait on the provider's allowance and honour Retry-After (invariant 7)

fsync.what: Each durable append ends in a sync to disk

llm.why: Parses every streamed token, copies the whole message into each delta, and sends every request

server.why: Numbers every delta into the event ring and sends one frame per delta to each viewer

client.why: Draws the whole answer again on every delta, on the viewer's device

desktop.why: Hosts the workspace client, so it draws every delta too

terminal.why: Draws the same stream as a client of the server

cli.why: Prints the stream as it arrives

admin.why: Its event hub carries every session's events

loop.why: Runs every step: dispatch, repair, cards, stop gate; a blind failure opens the breaker

context.why: Plans and assembles every request; what it carries is what each request costs

prompt.why: Resolves the prompt layers every turn; the prefix is in every request

capabilities.why: Decides which tool schemas every request carries

cards.why: Checks and records every card call; card schemas ride in the requests

control.why: Writes a decision at every decision point

permission.why: Decides every call; a provenance ask waits on a person

sandbox.why: Starts a sandboxed worker process for every tool call

tools.why: Runs every built-in tool call in the worker; a web fetch goes out to the network

mcp.why: Brokers every integration call to its server

recall.why: Answers recall calls, and what it returns rides in the next request

flows.why: Walks a flow's nodes as steps

ledger.why: Seals and syncs a frame for every entry

storage.why: Encrypts every object and moves refs under the writer epoch

catalog.why: Tails every ledger to index turns, calls and runs

telemetry.why: Writes about four content-free lines a step

runs.why: Opens and settles a run for every turn and records every effect

turn.why: Admits every turn: agent, trace key, route ladder

memory.why: Recalls notes into requests and writes new ones

operations.why: Projects receipts and incidents from the record

delivery.why: Renders each answer for its surface

gateway.why: Routes each channel message to a turn and sends the reply

backup.why: A backup holds everything the record grew by

lifecycle.why: The only thing that removes on a rule: retention decides how far the record grows

workers.why: A parent looks at a worker it waits on by a fixed tick

finops.why: Prices every receipt and stops admission when the day budget is spent

inbox.why: Holds what waits for the owner

library.why: Review and promotion wait for the owner; every version is kept

coworking.why: Shared conversations move at the people's pace

voice.why: Speech plays at speaking speed, whatever the model's

facts.meaning: Side chains rotate at 256 KiB plus a crossing frame; seal manifests still grow.
Conversation records, their objects and run records have no default expiry.
Sealing encrypted frames copies ciphertext; it does not compress it.
Document object collection has a one-hour grace and only releases unreachable objects.
Expiring side chains seal aged segments after 30 days; the newest sealed segment stays.
Cold session reads scan segments; bounded model context is not a bounded cold read.

storage.scope: Synthetic empty-home forecast; 30-day months. No private data read. No settings changed.
